agent.prompt: In nanobpm/nano-bpm, cut a coordinated release following RELEASE.md (the canonical procedure; read it first). (1) Open ONE version-bump PR titled `chore(release): gateway v<next> + engine-wasm <next>` (add nano-bernd only if the FFI ABI changed): bump server/Cargo.toml and processos/Cargo.toml for the gateway train, and engine-wasm/pkg.package.json for engine-wasm (the only engine-wasm version source; engine-wasm/pkg/ is a gitignored CI build output, never commit it). engine-wasm is 0.x: a minor bump if its JS/DTO surface changed since the last bojtos-npm-v* tag, else a patch. Call out every determinism upgrade boundary since the last gateway tag in the PR body (RELEASE.md section 1a). Converge the PR and merge it (nano-bpm merges via a standalone `@mergifyio queue` comment). (2) From the merge commit on origin/main, run `make release-tags` (dry run), then `make release-tags PUSH=1`; it pushes one tag per push and confirms each release workflow started. Do not hand-push tags. (3) Verify per RELEASE.md section 4: `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm version` and the gateway's `fix(binary): bundle nanobpmn <version>` PR on jwulf/c8ctl-plugin-nano.

In clients/engine-testkit: bump @nanobpm/engine-wasm range to the new version (assert it resolves past the 0.x caret trap), build+test, cut @nanobpm/engine-testkit (release-engine-testkit-npm.yml, OIDC).

In nanobpm/bojtos (one repo, semantic-release from .releaserc.json; bojtos-kit and bojtos-react are published together under one vX.Y.Z tag by scripts/release.mjs): bump the @nanobpm/engine-wasm range in bojtos-kit/package.json (and anywhere else it is declared) to the just-published version (0.x caret trap: ^0.11.0 does NOT admit 0.12.x, so the range must resolve to the new version), update lockfiles, build and test both packages, and land it with a conventional `feat:`/`fix:` PR title so semantic-release cuts a release on merge. Do not bump versions by hand. Wait for the release workflow to finish and confirm both @nanobpm/bojtos-kit and @nanobpm/bojtos-react were published at the new version.

wait.target: for u in @nanobpm/engine-wasm; do r=; for s in dependencies devDependencies peerDependencies; do r=$(npm view @nanobpm/bojtos-kit@latest $s.$u 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && break; done; [ -z "$r" ] && { echo no declared range for $u in @nanobpm/bojtos-kit; exit 1; }; m=$(npm view "$u@$r" version 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d "'" | awk '{print $NF}'); l=$(npm view $u version 2>/dev/null); [ "$m" = "$l" ] || { echo $u: range $r resolves $m not latest $l; exit 1; }; done; echo OK: @nanobpm/bojtos-kit resolves forward

for u in @nanobpm/bojtos-kit; do r=; for s in dependencies devDependencies peerDependencies; do r=$(npm view @nanobpm/bojtos-react@latest $s.$u 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && break; done; [ -z "$r" ] && { echo no declared range for $u in @nanobpm/bojtos-react; exit 1; }; m=$(npm view "$u@$r" version 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d "'" | awk '{print $NF}'); l=$(npm view $u version 2>/dev/null); [ "$m" = "$l" ] || { echo $u: range $r resolves $m not latest $l; exit 1; }; done; echo OK: @nanobpm/bojtos-react resolves forward
